subject: MAP: commitment timeline & GPU pool sizing for Nimbus POC
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@nimblanalytics.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@nimblanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: commitment timeline & GPU pool sizing for Nimbus POC

Alex —

Good to meet on the call yesterday. Per our discussion I sketched a short Mutual Action Plan so Nimbus can lock a POC start in mid‑June while ensuring we have Dedicated/Private capacity reserved ahead of your procurement windows. High level: 

- Goal: POC (3 weeks) start by week of 2026‑06‑15; ramp to pilot by 2026‑08.
- Commitment: Reserved Dedicated pool (16x A100‑L40 / ~256GB total GPU RAM) or Private deployment on your VPC — you pick by 2026‑04‑20.
- Lead times: Dedicated/GPU procurement + pool provisioning typically 6–8 weeks after signed reservation; Private (on our cloud partner) ~8–10 weeks for network/KMS + provisioning.
- Next steps: I attached a rough proposed GPU commitment spreadsheet and a HubSpot MAP link.

Attachments: proposed_gpu_commitment.xlsx (XLSX)
Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

Could you confirm decision owner(s) and procurement cadence so we can lock dates on our side? If Nimbus needs a longer lead time we can scope a smaller initial pool and schedule an aggressive scale plan in the MAP.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415‑555‑0186

From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@nimblanalytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@nimblanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: commitment timeline & GPU pool sizing for Nimbus POC

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear write‑up. Quick answers from our side:

- Decision owners: Priya (procurement) and myself (ML infra).
- Procurement window: We have a vendor review gate on 2026‑04‑22 and a budget approval on 2026‑05‑05. If we can get a reservation agreement prior to 04/22 that would accelerate approval.
- Preference: We prefer Dedicated pool for latency predictability, but need to confirm network/egress details for Private if that becomes required by security.

Question: your 6–8 week provisioning for Dedicated — does that assume you already have capacity in the region (us‑west) or is that tied to new hardware procurement? Also: can you provide a short spec sheet we can share with procurement (SOC2 section + lead times)?

I’ll loop Priya if we need a PO or SOW in advance.

— Alex
Director, ML Platform | Nimbus Analytics
alex.gomez@nimblanalytics.com

Subject: Fwd: MAP: commitment timeline & GPU pool sizing for Nimbus POC — need sizing + lead‑time confirmation

Team —

Fwd’ing Alex’s reply from Nimbus. They want Dedicated if possible, decision alignment is around 04/22 (vendor gate) and budget on 05/05. Can you confirm:

1) If we can provision a 16x A100‑L40 pool in us‑west within 6 weeks of a signed reservation, or do we need to allocate from spare capacity / dedicated backlog?
2) If Private is selected, what’s the realistic timeline for VPC + KMS onboarding + full parity (config + infra)?

I attached the proposed commitment spreadsheet they saw. I’ll draft a one‑page MAP that lists milestones and owner commitments once we confirm provisioning timelines.

— Vanessa

Vanessa / Karthik —

Short answer: yes, we can support a 16x A100‑L40 Dedicated pool in us‑west as long as the reservation is signed by 2026‑04‑20. That matches our current capacity plan and avoids waiting on a new hardware batch. If they sign after 04/20 we fall into the next provisioning window (~8–10 weeks).

Private timeline: estimate 8–10 weeks post‑SOW for VPC + KMS + compliance checks (SOC2 evidence review already on file for Nimbus should shorten this).

I’m attaching the GPU spec sheet and a proposed minimal starter pool option (8x A100‑L40) they can use to hit the earlier date while we stage additional nodes. If they need a guaranteed throughput SLA, we should push for the 16x commitment.

Attachments: attached_gpuspec_sheet.pdf (PDF)

Marissa Cole

Subject: MAP & next steps — Nimbus POC reservation and signature link

Alex / Priya —

Thanks — this is great. Based on internal confirmation below we can do the following MAP and milestones to align with your 04/22 vendor gate: 

MAP (mutual action plan) highlights:
- 2026‑04‑12: Redwood to provide formal one‑page MAP + reservation SOW (attached link).
- 2026‑04‑20: Nimbus to sign reservation for initial 8x A100‑L40 (starter) OR full 16x A100‑L40. Signing by this date guarantees a Dedicated pool provisioned within 6 weeks.
- 2026‑05‑05: Budget approval target (your internal).
- 2026‑06‑15: Target POC start (3‑week scope).

We’ve created a DocuSign link to reserve capacity; signing the reservation triggers billing and queue placement. If Nimbus prefers, we can sign an initial 8x starter to meet the 04/20 timeline and automatically scale to 16x after budget approval — we’ll include automatic rollup in the SOW.

DocuSign: https://redwood.example.com/docusign/NIM-2026-04-reservation
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

Let me know if you want a short one‑pager for your procurement packet that calls out SOC2 evidence and the expedited provisioning SLA. If you’re good I’ll send the DocuSign and the one‑page MAP by Monday morning.
